comparison.objective: Execute a safe make-before-break pump changeover, starting standby before stopping duty; unrelated to damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered physical control actuation and status confirmation, without fine mechanical adjustment or tool engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Standby B running and holding pressure before A stops; flow must never be interrupted. Numeric pressure/flow thresholds are missing. Candidate requires isolated adjustment followed by repeated physical cycles.
comparison.reason: The shared use of controls is generic; sequencing a redundant process system is a different tested ability.
